correspondence_policy: Reference chain orderA,B,C,D. Permute mobile chains only within each declared subunit class, considering all4class-preserving bijections. Within a chain, match the same original selected residue ID and verify its residue identity; no residue permutation or inferred missing coordinates. All4chains have the same27selected positions, so pooling is equal point weight.
model_comparison: For every allowed mapping, minimize summed squared selected-point residuals first with one shared proper rigid transform for the entire4-chain cohort, and separately with one independent proper rigid transform per matched chain. Minimize each model over all allowed mappings. RMSD is sqrt(SSE/total_selected_points). Report1-minimum_independent_chain_SSE/minimum_global_SSE. Distinct best mappings or proper symmetry ties require no arbitrary chain-map answer.

representation_provenance.mobile: Official2DN1oxy biological assembly1downloaded as2DN1.pdb1. Its two model records encode spatial assembly copies, not alternative conformers. The supplied protein-ATOM derivative flattens those copies into one model, maps model1A/BtoA/Band model2A/BtoC/D, and changes only chain/serial/record framing. Original protein atom coordinates, residue IDs, occupancies and altlocs are preserved. Hetero atoms and ANISOU records are outside this CA comparison.

provenance.kind: Two actual deposited human hemoglobin structures from the same primary structural study; source-faithful assembly representation only, no regenerated coordinates.
